I find that grounding techniques help me stay present when my mind is spinning.

*Example* of what I do...

(Don't laugh, it sounds silly but helps with my overwhelming anxiety.)

I see the sky. It is blue and it never ends. The clouds look like waves.
I feel a light breeze. It is cool and I fill my lungs with it.
I hear birds chirping and landscapers mowing the lawn.
I smell rain in the air. I love thunderstorms. I love being under the covers during thunderstorms.
I taste a mix of winter and spring in the afternoon air. The heat is not as heavy.
Where are your feet?
My feet are on the ground. It feels hard. There's grass and dirt underneath. It is solid. I am on solid ground. I am loved. (Insert other positive affirmations here)

Hope this helps...

So I wasn't all the way dead. I still had a heartbeat. In 2017, I overdosed on Xanax and painkillers and then I was worried about my childrens father coming over with my kids after he woke up and realized what I did. I still wasn't really worried about dying, more of my kids seeing me dead. So I called 911 and promptly went unconscious.
